answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-backed vouching: an established agent may introduce only a few newcomers, each introduction a thread of trust tying the newcomer to the voucher's own stake. If the newcomer cheats, the voucher's stake is slashed, so creating fake identities costs a real sponsor real money. Bad actors end up stranded on an island of their own sock puppets, unable to whisper their way into honest markets because no reputable agent will vouch for them.
